The '''Q'nithian system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It contained the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Aeropteryx]] [[Species/Legends|species]] as well as just one [[Moon/Legends|moon]] with an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] that supported a [[q'nithian mimbrane]] colony.
